title: The Tidal Dark
text: The dark comes in like a tide, rolling and black, swallowing the land, then goes out again. Each time it leaves something on the shore: a shoe, a sword, a face, a child's toy. The tide is coming in again.

options.label: Comb the shore between tides for what the dark leaves behind.

outcomes.text: You gather strange stones, heavy with essence.
The tide comes in early. For a while you are under it.

options.label: The quickest runs the shore at low tide and races the dark back.

outcomes.text: They are back with an armful before the dark returns.

options.label: Keep to high ground and watch what the tide does.

outcomes.text: You watch the tide take something that was walking toward you. Its shape tells you what lies ahead.
